However trumped-up the war was, they still did their duty and died.|[[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|contractor]] [[Kal Skirata]], speaking of the fallen [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]|<ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>}}
The '''First Battle Memorial''' was a large, commemorative monument meant to honor the many [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone soldiers]] who [[Death/Legends|perished]] in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|opening battle]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. An enormous slab of Geonosian rock, the sculpted wall was engraved with the numerical designations of the fallen [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] and erected in the outdoor plaza of the [[Republic military base]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]], where it remained for the duration of the war.

==Description==
The First Battle Memorial<ref name="EpisodeGuide" /> was an enormous slab of [[Color/Legends|reddish-brown]] rock,<ref name="Facebook" /> drawn from a [[Geonosian spire]], polished<ref name="EpisodeGuide" /> and carved to form a thick, three-dimensional rectangle.<ref name="Much" /> Engraved into the stone in black [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] lettering were the designations of the<ref name="Facebook" /> thousands of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> who [[Death/Legends|died]] during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|first battle]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] on Geonosis. Near the monument's center, the words "Battle of Geonosis" were etched in Aurebesh, and above which the [[Republic crest/Legends|Galactic Roundel]] was inlaid.<ref name="Facebook" /> The First Battle Memorial was placed at the heart of the [[Republic military base]]'s outdoor plaza on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where it stood between two large, grey obelisks bearing sculpted clone [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] statues. At night, the memorial was illuminated by several lights at the base of the monument.<ref name="Much" />

==History==
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] soldiers of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] were deployed to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of Geonosis, where they clashed with the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid armies]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Though the Republic would ultimately emerge victorious, thousands of clone troopers perished in the fighting. From the battle on Geonosis, [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] became embroiled in a conflict that came to be known as the Clone Wars, as the Galactic Republic and Confederacy fought across a multitude of worlds.<ref name="NEC" />

To honor the clone troopers who fell in combat during the Clone Wars' first battle, a memorial was commissioned to commemorate their service.<ref name="Facebook" /> Erected on the Republic capital of Coruscant, in the heart of the plaza outside the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic military]] base, the First Battle Memorial was completed<ref name="Much" /> prior to [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]. That year,<ref name="Date">{{TCWdates|518}}</ref> the fugitive [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] [[Escape from the Republic military base/Legends|fled the Republic military base]] where she had been [[Prisoner/Legends|incarcerated]] on false charges of murder, running along the top of the First Battle Memorial to evade pursuing [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|security forces]].<ref name="Much" />

In the [[Standard day/Legends|days]] that followed the Clone Wars' end, the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|military contractor]] [[Kal Skirata]]—a former member of the ''[[Cuy'val Dar]]'' and military adviser to the Republic's Grand Army during the war—began to formulate plans for a new memorial for fallen clone troopers.<ref name="O66" /> Unlike the First Battle Memorial,<ref name="Facebook" /> Skirata aimed to create a monument to commemorate every trooper who died in service to the Republic during the course of the entire war,<ref name="O66" /> rather than just its opening battle.<ref name="Facebook" />

==Behind the scenes==
The monument wall was first introduced in the eighteenth episode of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' television series']] [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season]], "[[The Jedi Who Knew Too Much]]," which debuted on Canadian television on [[February 15]], [[2013]], before airing the following day in the United States. The monument featured as a notable set piece during protagonist Ahsoka Tano's escape from Republic custody. Shortly after the episode's Canadian premiere, a [https://www.facebook.com/photo.php?fbid=511299472242685&set=a.350962014943099.76071.328988200473814 post] on the [https://www.facebook.com/StarWarsTheCloneWars official ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Facebook page] elaborated upon the nature and significance of the memorial, which was later provided a proper name in the [[StarWars.com]] Trivia Gallery for "The Jedi Who Knew Too Much."

The memorial is supposed to list the designations of the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] that fell during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]];<ref name="Much Trivia">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/the-jedi-who-knew-too-much-trivia-gallery|text="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much" Trivia Gallery|quote=The monument at the center of the Republic military base plaza is an enormous slab of Geonosian rock that lists the names of the clone troopers that fell in action in the first battle of the Clone Wars.}} {{C|Slide 9}}</ref> however, when translated, nearly all the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] inscriptions turn out to be nothing but meaningless gibberish. The only part that makes sense is the mirror-inverted Aurebesh "headline" in the middle of the monument, which says "BATTLT TT [[Geonosis/Legends|GEONOSIS]]," although some of the Ts are sideways or upside-down.<ref name="Much" /> According to the Trivia Gallery for "The Jedi Who Knew Too Much" on StarWars.com, it is supposed to read "BATTLE OF GEONOSIS."<ref name="Much Trivia" />
